authority: JAYT-392 final directive supplied directly by user
reviewer: Codex CEO; Gemini independently reviews the final dual-key seal

prohibitions: Do not bypass WAF, CAPTCHA, authentication, access controls, rate limits, robots directives, paywalls, geofencing or provider terms.
Do not fabricate, alter or infer captures, screenshots, prices, dates, eligibility, scope, codes, images, task logs, Vercel logs or attribution.
Do not claim an offer is live, a product is verified, a scheduler is running, or a drill is measured unless its underlying retained evidence independently proves it.

required_results.scope: Metiz Cinema Helio and Galaxy Cinema Da Nang
requirements: Each offer has original first-party response bytes and, if used, original screenshot bytes with source URL, capture timestamp, viewport/browser metadata and SHA-256.
Each offer has byte-locatable offer_quote, validity_quote showing September 2026 currency/current status, scope_quote for the Da Nang branch and terms_quote for actual eligibility.
The two offers must have distinct source-backed benefit/redemption routes; duplicated Galaxy tariff/U22 claims count once.
No self-reference to jayt.vn and no copy-code control unless the source visibly provides that exact public code.
Publish CTA only as justified by its source: counter, app or schedule.
Remove the 30 visually broken placeholder cards from the verified Radar UI. An empty/neutral state is permitted and must be clearly labelled rather than styled as a verified product.

For every product card shown as a verified surveyed item, retain a correct official PNG/WebP photo, rights/source record, item/variant match, observed-price timestamp, official Mall destination, file hash and dimensions.
If fewer than ten records pass, show only that exact verified count; do not pad the experience with generic, generated or mismatched imagery.
Keep affiliate_enabled false without provider-issued replayable attribution proof.
Register an actual OS scheduler task/service with four-hour cadence, fixed item IDs, least-privilege identity and no auto-publication capability.

Submit raw scheduler registration/query output, task executable/config hashes, PID/process evidence, system timestamps and a durable audit log from a scheduler-triggered (not manually invoked) network probe run.

Perform a reversible actual alias swap only on an authorized non-production drill alias. Retain Vercel command/API output, alias mapping before/after, repeated CDN response logs, rollback restoration proof and measured RTO.
Canonical production alias must remain untouched during the drill.
Refresh PIPELINE_SEAL_MANIFEST with hashes for executed collectors, validators, schemas, scheduler config and drill artifacts.

Status stays PENDING_DUAL_KEY until a Chairman written-approval reference and an independently supplied Gemini safety-review reference are present. A seal manifest does not physically prevent all filesystem modifications.

ceo_gate.approval: CEO independently checks retained source bytes, screenshots, current dates, quote locations, UI output, scheduler registration/log and Vercel drill evidence.
ceo_gate.pass: Only if at least two unique current Da Nang offers and every asserted verified Radar item pass; exact count must be reported.
ceo_gate.hold: Any missing/old/duplicate/non-local offer, unverified media, simulated task/drill, or missing proof holds canonical release and affiliate activation.

reporting.ack: Report actual executor acknowledgement and start time.
reporting.completion: Report evidence paths, hashes, verified counts and blockers. Executor cannot self-award CEO/Gemini pass or mutate production before the CEO gate.
